scope: All 237 noncanonical live v019 forms in the 'following/next' participial family: 13 slědeč- forms and 224 slědujuč- forms.
choice: Normalize the complete family to the official slědujući paradigm in the edition's ć orthography, joining 52 already-canonical forms; repair the malformed feminine locative slědujučnoj as slědujućej.
motivation: The official active-participial adjective is slědujući. The corpus mixed an unlicensed slědeč- stem with a hard-č spelling and the canonical ć form. These variants all express the same grammatical meaning and their mixture was a source-layer artifact, not a useful pan-Slavic distinction.
alternatives_rejected: Retain slědeč- as a free variant; it is absent as the official lemma and duplicates the established participial family.
Keep hard č in this one family; that contradicts both the official slědujući form and the edition's adopted ć/đ orthography.
Replace every form with slědny; that valid type-1 adjective is not an exact grammatical substitute for all participial constructions.

validation.coverage: 237/237 noncanonical whole-token forms changed exactly once
validation.residue: zero slědeč- and hard-č slědujuč- forms; exactly 289 canonical slědujuć- forms
validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
